summary: Add a typed SQL database binding with checked-in migrations and isolated local tests before provisioning production.
description: Add Drizzle access to a typed Cloudflare D1 binding, checked-in SQL migrations and isolated database tests. Development and verify use local D1 without a cloud account, and a readiness route proves a real query through the framework. Production provisioning and reviewed remote migrations are separate steps. This is a storage foundation; it does not add a product data model or authentication.
seoDescription: Cloudflare D1 with Drizzle, typed Worker bindings, checked-in SQL migrations and isolated local database tests without a cloud account.

projectExamples.title: Saved resource directory
projectExamples.description: Create listing tables, search queries and editing routes on local D1. Add authentication before exposing private edits or records.

projectExamples.title: Scheduled snapshot archive
projectExamples.description: Store results from custom scheduled work in D1. Implement the data collection and schedule; the base scheduled handler is a no-op.

plain.whatItIs: Adds a small SQL database to a Cloudflare Workers web app, with saved steps for creating and changing tables and tests that need no cloud account.
goodAt: Running database tests on your own computer without a cloud account
Reading and writing rows from a Workers app through a typed connection
notGoodAt: Projects that need PostgreSQL; this uses a different database that Cloudflare provides.

requests: store records from my Worker through a typed database client
develop database changes locally without opening a cloud account
test SQL migrations without touching my development database
